title: Create a tensor
summary: A PyTorch tensor stores numbers with a shape and a data type. torch.tensor makes one from a small Python list.
introduction: A PyTorch tensor stores numbers with a shape and a data type. torch.tensor makes one from a small Python list. We will use a small example so you can follow each step.
learningObjectives: Use the example to answer a practice question

blocks.text: A PyTorch tensor stores numbers with a shape and a data type. torch.tensor makes one from a small Python list.

blocks.title: Before you start
blocks.text: Run these examples only in a separate Python environment with PyTorch installed. A CPU setup is enough for the tiny examples; no hosted model or secret key is required.
This course teaches the basics. It does not cover every feature of PyTorch. Keep real personal data and secret keys out of practice files.
The output is [2, 4, 6]. tolist returns ordinary Python values for easy inspection.

items: Read the example from top to bottom. Point to the part that uses the new idea.
Explain what changed in your own words. Check the example again if you get stuck.

blocks.title: A common mistake
blocks.text: A tensor is a data container, not a trained model by itself.
For more detail later, use this [PyTorch further reading](https://pytorch.org/tutorials/beginner/basics/intro.html).
